QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] Setting the Scene
QuestInfo.0: Carta feels something bad is happening in Aquarium's Deep Sea. She reluctantly casts a spell to see what's become of the expedition team.
QuestInfo.1: Carta feels something bad is happening in Aquarium's Deep Sea. She reluctantly casts a spell and learns that the Holychorus was damaged, the expedition team disappeared, and a new world lies beyond the tunnel.
QuestInfo.2: Carta saw everything that transpired. Surprisingly, she complimented the expedition team and hinted that they may still be alive.
